scope: Read-only account contract inspection plus local source, privacy-boundary and regression-test review. Reviewer executed no workflow or remote mutation; root-authorized real probes are recorded separately.

findings.issue: Generic about/tell terms matched product metadata and invoked the provider for an unrelated question.
findings.resolution: Generic request terms excluded from retrieval; unrelated-topic orchestration regression passes.

findings.issue: Workflow read/validation failures bypassed the cache-miss cooldown before a billable reservation.
findings.resolution: Durable lastProbeAt limits read failures too. Pure budget evaluation preserves prior-day state during failed probes; rollover regression passes.

findings.issue: Fixtures and the earlier normalized receipt incorrectly implied attributes.status; actual API returns instanceStatus.detailsKind and pending IN_PROGRESS.
findings.resolution: Public and private adapters read the current machine field, accept finite compatibility variants without conflicting aliases, and recognize IN_PROGRESS and terminal INSTANCE_ERROR. Contract evidence corrected.

findings.issue: The real workflow includes a static prefix before its one Trigger.question binding.
findings.resolution: Bounded static wrapper accepted; additional bindings/context and conversation parameters rejected.

limits: Review covers the inspected code and tests, not general security certification.
Account-side tools/model/retention/spending settings remain as documented in the separate contract report.
Local run caps do not prove monetary allowance; no billing amount or private account identifiers were recorded.
A root-authorized fixed-public-packet run passed and a cache read made zero additional requests. Service activation remains separate deployment evidence.

rootAuthorizedLiveVerification.scope: Configured Datadog agent selected IDs from approved public excerpts; text and citations were reconstructed locally. This verifies narrow workflow-backed inference, not unrestricted chat or model-generated financial advice.
